bridge.channelAllBotPreview: UI-only: Web composer preview of who an @all mention would wake
bridge.channelReadPosition: UI-only: Web unread divider position for one viewer
bridge.composerIdentity: UI-only: names the identity the Web composer shows; send already posts as the Host owner
bridge.composerValidate: UI-only: pre-send check for the Web composer's attachments and reply target; send runs the same Host checks
bridge.messageAttachmentTarget: UI-only: resolves a local file path so the Web UI can open or reveal an attachment in the OS
bridge.onboarding: UI-only: Web tutorial progress and steps
bridge.onboardingModel: UI-only: the Web tutorial's model step; model-preset-apply and model-plan configure models from the CLI
bridge.workspaceFileTarget: UI-only: resolves a Workspace folder path so the Web UI can open it in the OS; grants lists the paths

routes./api/computer/diagnostics/viewer: UI-only: the Web Client's Computer viewer reports its own connection events here; an agent reads them with computer-diagnostics

tools.ask_secret: Opens a private input card that resumes the calling Bot turn; the ask-secret-* commands cover the Human side.
tools.ask_user_question: DSH native question card that pauses the calling Agent turn; user-question-status and user-question-answer cover the Human side.
tools.bot_subagent: Starts a child DSH Agent from the calling Bot's running Agent; there is no parent Agent outside a Bot turn.
tools.bot_subagent_fork: Forks a child DSH Agent from the calling Bot's completed turns; there is no parent Agent outside a Bot turn.
tools.channel_read_image: Returns the image to the calling model as input; with no model there is nothing to receive it. channel_read and channel_attachment_save cover the file.
tools.create_assignment: Starts an Assignment owned by the Source Event of the calling Bot turn; reach it through send and inspect it with bot-trace.
tools.list_bot_subagent_models: Reads the delegation routes of the calling Agent's Subagent tools and is registered only on a running Agent.
tools.list_subagent_models: Reads the delegation routes of the calling Agent's Subagent tools and is registered only on a running Agent.
tools.memory_continue_from_commit: Coordinates the Memory working tree with the running Orchestrator turn; the Human Memory commands cover it (#1693).
tools.memory_switch_branch: Coordinates the Memory working tree with the running Orchestrator turn; the Human Memory commands cover it (#1693).
tools.report_to_orchestrator: Assignment-turn tool whose report identity is the running Assignment Turn.
tools.request_workspace_grant: The Human decision on its card resumes the requesting Orchestrator Session; grant-create grants the folder without the model.
tools.secret_mcp_disconnect: Stops MCP servers attached to the calling Agent; bound to a running Agent.
tools.send_assignment_request: Its report returns to the calling Orchestrator Session, which only exists during a Bot turn.
tools.subagent: DSH native Subagent spawned from the calling Agent; there is no parent Agent outside a Bot turn.
tools.subagent_fork: DSH native Subagent forked from the calling Agent's turns; there is no parent Agent outside a Bot turn.
tools.wait_for_assignment: Blocks the calling Bot turn until an Assignment reports; there is no turn to block without the model.
